fields.Name: IT150 - Entity Status Push Fan-out over WebSocket
fields.Description: Two WebSocket sessions of one user each subscribe to status updates. SF1 the saving session receives one save push for its own record; SF2 the other session of the same user receives that push too; SF3 an update reaches both sessions exactly once each. Mutating; self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every active session of the user receives each entity save push exactly once.
